SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(spot_level), ''), '未评级') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM biz_scenic_spot WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY spot_level ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT city AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM biz_scenic_spot WHERE del_flag = '0' AND city IS NOT NULL AND city != '' GROUP BY city ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 8
SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(province), ''), '未知') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM biz_scenic_spot WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY province ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.d, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(m.id) AS count FROM (SELECT CURDATE() - INTERVAL 6 DAY AS d UNION ALL SELECT CURDATE() - INTERVAL 5 DAY UNION ALL SELECT CURDATE() - INTERVAL 4 DAY UNION ALL SELECT CURDATE() - INTERVAL 3 DAY UNION ALL SELECT CURDATE() - INTERVAL 2 DAY UNION ALL SELECT CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 DAY UNION ALL SELECT CURDATE()) d LEFT JOIN biz_chat_message m ON DATE(m.send_time) = d.d AND m.message_role = 'user' GROUP BY d.d ORDER BY d.d

SELECT '景点咨询' AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM biz_chat_message WHERE message_role = 'user' AND (message_content LIKE '%景点%' OR message_content LIKE '%景区%' OR message_content LIKE '%门票%' OR message_content LIKE '%玩%') UNION ALL SELECT '行程规划', COUNT(*) FROM biz_chat_message WHERE message_role = 'user' AND (message_content LIKE '%行程%' OR message_content LIKE '%路线%' OR message_content LIKE '%规划%' OR message_content LIKE '%天%') UNION ALL SELECT '美食推荐', COUNT(*) FROM biz_chat_message WHERE message_role = 'user' AND (message_content LIKE '%吃%' OR message_content LIKE '%美食%' OR message_content LIKE '%小吃%') UNION ALL SELECT '交通住宿', COUNT(*) FROM biz_chat_message WHERE message_role = 'user' AND (message_content LIKE '%住%' OR message_content LIKE '%酒店%' OR message_content LIKE '%交通%' OR message_content LIKE '%车%' OR message_content LIKE '%飞机%') UNION ALL SELECT '其他', COUNT(*) FROM biz_chat_message WHERE message_role = 'user' AND message_content NOT LIKE '%景点%' AND message_content NOT LIKE '%景区%' AND message_content NOT LIKE '%门票%' AND message_content NOT LIKE '%玩%' AND message_content NOT LIKE '%行程%' AND message_content NOT LIKE '%路线%' AND message_content NOT LIKE '%规划%' AND message_content NOT LIKE '%天%' AND message_content NOT LIKE '%吃%' AND message_content NOT LIKE '%美食%' AND message_content NOT LIKE '%小吃%' AND message_content NOT LIKE '%住%' AND message_content NOT LIKE '%酒店%' AND message_content NOT LIKE '%交通%' AND message_content NOT LIKE '%车%' AND message_content NOT LIKE '%飞机%'

SELECT m1.message_content AS question, LEFT(IFNULL(( SELECT m2.message_content FROM biz_chat_message m2 WHERE m2.session_id = m1.session_id AND m2.message_role = 'assistant' AND m2.id > m1.id ORDER BY m2.id ASC LIMIT 1 ), '暂无回复'), 120) AS answer, DATE_FORMAT(m1.send_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS askTime FROM biz_chat_message m1 WHERE m1.message_role = 'user' ORDER BY m1.send_time DESC LIMIT 10
